definition: Expert performance is highly skilled performance that depends not only on technical ability but also on perceiving the demands of the setting and adjusting actions to fit them. In this source, it refers especially to musicians using their musical understanding to adapt to different acoustic environments so their playing remains clear, expressive, and communicative.
